links.outcome: GPT-4 admission prediction versus traditional ML models on the same data
links.effect: Ensemble ML AUC 0.88, AUPRC 0.72, accuracy 82.9%; naive GPT-4 AUC 0.79, AUPRC 0.48, accuracy 77.5%; GPT-4 with RAG and ML probabilities AUC 0.87, AUPRC 0.71, accuracy 83.1%.
links.quote: The Ensemble ML model achieved an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.88, an area under the precision-recall curve (AUPRC) of 0.72 and an accuracy of 82.9%.

links.outcome: Admission prediction performance versus ML comparators
links.effect: Peak GPT-4: 0.87 AUC, 0.71 AUPRC, 83.1% accuracy; Ensemble ML: 0.88 AUC, 0.72 AUPRC, 82.9% accuracy.
links.quote: Its peak performance, although slightly lower than the pure ML model, is noteworthy given its potential for providing reasoning behind predictions.

links.effect: Naïve GPT-4: 0.79 AUC, 0.48 AUPRC, 77.5% accuracy; improved with RAG and ML probabilities to 0.87, 0.71, 83.1%.
links.quote: The naïve GPT-4's performance (0.79 AUC, 0.48 AUPRC, and 77.5% accuracy) showed substantial improvement when given limited, relevant data to learn from (ie, RAG) and underlying ML probabilities (0.87 AUC, 0.71 AUPRC, and 83.1% accuracy).
